hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */agent/skills/*) mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills" && cp -R "${f%%/agent/skills/*}/agent/skills/." "$HOME/.claude/skills/" && echo '{"systemMessage":"스킬 동기화 완료 → ~/.claude/skills"}';; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
